nodes.name: ChatPage.css
nodes.summary: Layout stylesheet for the chat page shell, defining the full-viewport flex container, the chat card surface, an absolutely-positioned upgrade badge, and a placeholder hint shown when no conversation is active.

nodes.name: HomePage.css
nodes.summary: Landing/hero page stylesheet centering a dark full-screen layout with a badge, logo, tagline, and primary/outline call-to-action buttons, including a responsive breakpoint for narrow viewports.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (design tokens like --font-body, --color-primary) for consistent theming and a max-width media query for mobile layout adjustments.

nodes.name: LoginPage.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the login form card, covering the centered page background, card container, title/subtitle typography, input fields, error message styling, and submit button hover/disabled states.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies heavily on shared CSS custom properties (colors, radii, shadows) for theme consistency with the rest of the app.
